title: 第11章知道错了？不，你只是知道自己要死了
slug: 斗罗开局被逼入赘对象宁荣荣
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

不知何时，脚下竟已经多了一道道漆黑色的纹路。

诡异至极。

迈尔斯厉喝一声，脚下六道魂环骤然浮现，武魂瞬间附体，浑身肌肉猛然膨胀，双拳紧握，魂力外放，想要将靠近的蛛纹尽数震碎。

但蛛纹碎裂的速度远不及蔓延的速度，漆黑色的纹路被震碎后转眼便如同活物般重新凝聚，以更快的速度向他的脚下蔓延。

等迈尔斯回过神来，目之所及，地面上、墙壁上、天花板上，已经全被漆黑色的纹路所覆盖。

而自己，正处中心。

随着周围被彻底黑色纹路覆盖，空气变得粘稠，魂力像是被灌了铅，那一瞬间迈尔斯彻底慌了。

这恐怖的压制力，绝对是领域！

面对拥有领域的魂师，自己根本不可能是对手。

只有逃或许才有一线生机！

他猛地转身，朝着门口冲去。

就在此刻，脚下的漆黑纹路亮起一抹幽光。

细密的声响传来，如同蚕丝被绷紧时的颤鸣。纹路仿佛活了过来，诡异地蠕动着。

而在迈尔斯即将触碰到大门的那一刻整个人再也动弹不得。

低头看去，不知何时，脚腕已经缠满了蛛丝，正顺着小腿一路向上蔓延，无声无息地攀附、收紧。

紧接着，成千上万根漆黑如墨的蛛丝从地面升腾而起，细如发丝，却闪烁着金属般的冷光，在空气中交织、缠绕、编织，以一种诡异而精密的规律织出了一张巨大而绚丽的蛛网。

而他，已无路可逃。

“迈尔斯，好久不见。”

听到声音，迈尔斯僵硬地转过头，看向窗台的方向。

那里不知何时多了一个人，像是凭空出现的，无声无息。

月光下，紫色的发在夜风中微微飘动，淡金色的瞳孔中血色翻涌，却平静得可怕。

“真，真的是你。”

“当年的事是我的错，你想要什么？只要我有的，我都可以给你，只求你放过我。”迈尔斯的声音在发抖，但还在撑着。

“放过你，可你当年放过我了吗？”

江蓠的声音很轻，甚至有些温柔。但听在迈尔斯耳中，却如同恶魔的低语。

迈尔斯还想说什么，但蛛丝已经封住了他的嘴，整个身体被彻底包裹，只露出一个脑袋。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

At some point, there were dark lines under his feet.

Extremely weird.

Miles shouted sharply, and six soul rings suddenly appeared under his feet. The martial soul instantly possessed him, and the muscles all over his body suddenly expanded. He clenched his fists and released his soul power, trying to shatter all the approaching spider patterns.

However, the speed at which the spider pattern fragmented was far less than the speed at which it spread. After being shattered, the pitch-black pattern regrouped in the blink of an eye like a living creature, spreading to his feet at a faster speed.

When Miles came back to his senses, as far as he could see, the ground, walls, and ceiling were all covered in dark lines.

And he is in the center.

As the surroundings were completely covered with black lines, the air became thicker, and the soul power seemed to be filled with lead. At that moment, Miles was completely panicked.

This terrifying suppressive power is definitely a domain!

Facing a soul master with a domain, he could never be his opponent.

Only by escaping may there be a chance of survival!

He turned sharply and rushed towards the door.

At this moment, the dark lines under his feet lit up with a faint light.

A thin sound came, like the trembling of silk threads being stretched.The lines seemed to come alive and squirm strangely.

And the moment Miles was about to touch the door, he couldn't move anymore.

Looking down, I don't know when my ankles have been wrapped with spider silk, which is spreading all the way up my calves, clinging and tightening silently.

Immediately afterwards, thousands of jet-black spider silks rose from the ground, as thin as hair, but shimmering with a metallic cold light. They intertwined, entangled, and weaved in the air, weaving a huge and gorgeous spider web in a strange and precise pattern.

And he had no way to escape.

"Miles, long time no see."

Hearing the sound, Miles turned his head stiffly and looked in the direction of the window sill.

I don't know when there was an extra person there, seemingly appearing out of thin air and making no sound.

Under the moonlight, her purple hair fluttered slightly in the night wind, and her pale golden pupils were filled with blood, but they were terrifyingly calm.

"Really, it's really you."

"What happened back then was my fault. What do you want? As long as I have it, I can give it to you. I just ask you to let me go." Miles's voice was trembling, but he was still holding on.

"Let you go, but did you let me go back then?"

Jiang Li's voice was very soft, even a little gentle.But to Miles' ears, it sounded like a devil's whisper.

Miles wanted to say something else, but the spider silk had already sealed his mouth, and his entire body was completely wrapped, with only one head exposed.
